task.population: Adults aged at least 18 with recorded sex F or M in the selected Turkana 2018-2019 study-protocol target context; demographic and lifestyle mixture unspecified

model.family: Sex-stratified Gaussian copula with lognormal BMI and lipids and shifted-lognormal age

lipids.conditional_log_variance_rule: For each lipid, choose one log variance shared across sexes so that the sex mixture has the specified pooled arithmetic mean and variance.

dependence.rank_bridge: For a continuous Gaussian copula, latent Pearson correlation equals 2*sin(pi*Spearman/6).
dependence.sex_invariance: The latent correlation matrix is shared across sexes; conditional marginal distributions differ by sex.

parameter_uncertainty.treatment: Fixed plug-in scenario; no parameter draws or posterior interpretation.
parameter_uncertainty.source_intervals: No confidence interval or standard error is converted into individual dispersion.

sampling.row_law: Independent identically distributed draws from the declared mixture.
sampling.latent_site_or_lifestyle_classes: Not introduced; their unknown mixture is absorbed into the assumed joint distribution.

measurement.age: Continuous representation of recorded interview age, without a separate reporting-error model.
measurement.sex: Literal recorded F/M field; F is mapped to external female/women strata and M to male/men strata as an explicit assumption.
measurement.bmi: Observed measured-weight/height BMI; no separate anthropometric-error layer.
measurement.lipids: Observed lipid results represented in mmol/L. External source moments are used as numerical scenario anchors, without an estimated assay or fasting correction.

support.age: Strictly above the lower bound, with no finite upper bound.
support.bmi_and_lipids: Strictly positive, continuous and unbounded above.
support.tc_hdl_ordering: No TC>=HDL constraint, clipping or rejection.
support.tail_family: Lognormal conditional tails; age has an additive lower-bound shift.
